steps.purpose: recover pending work and dependency state
select Minimum Trustworthy Path within caller authority
independently test behavioral contract when browser/runtime verification applies
normalize evidence and update bounded operational statistics
complete, retry, block, or create improvement candidate

invariants: scheduler starts work but does not authorize it
workflow persists execution but does not promote logic
coordinator routes but does not self-authorize
executor cannot validate its own success when independent verification is required
evidence may update bounded statistics but cannot silently change canonical logic
